channel.title: The Grant Desk - Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, LatAm, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, LatAm, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Red Quincho: Beca Constelaciones 2026 (4th Edition)
    https://redquincho.ar/beca-constelaciones-2026/
    Red Quincho · deadline Closed 09 Aug 2026 · ARS 1,000,000 (around USD 690) per grant toward mobility, living costs and production, plus one month of lodging. 15 grants available. No application fee.
